sloka: तेषां शतसहस्राणि तदा लङ्कानिवासिनाम्।अदहत् पावकस्तत्र जज्वाल च पुनःपुनः ।। ६.७५.१७ ।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ śatasahasrāṇi tadā laṅkānivāsinām।adahat pāvakastatra jajvāla ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.75.17 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.
